title: Mercantile Bank Corporation Announces FDIC and Michigan DIFS Approval of Merger of Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank
summary: Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") announced today that each of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (the "FDIC") and Michigan Department of Insurance and Financial Services ("DIFS") has approved Mercantile Bank's application to merge Eastern Michigan Bank with and into Mercantile Bank and to establish the twelve offices of Eastern Michigan Bank as branches of the resulting bank.
